'''Desiraye Dusat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Desiraye Dusat appears as a Bounty Hunter gear vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. He was later removed during a gear system restructuring.
